Guiding Case No. 252

Zhejiang Mou New Materials Co., Ltd. — Series of Enforcement Implementation Cases

(Discussed and adopted by the Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court, released on April 7, 2025)

Keywords: enforcement / enforcement implementation / designated enforcement / connection between enforcement and bankruptcy

Ruling Gist

1. Where multiple enforcement cases involve the same judgment debtor and different people's courts have separately filed and enforced them, and it is convenient for one people's court to carry out the enforcement work in a unified manner to timely and effectively conduct the enforcement, the higher people's court may designate one of those people's courts to enforce them in a unified manner.

2. Where, during the enforcement process, the judgment debtor enterprise enters into pre-reorganization proceedings, the case may be designated to a people's court with bankruptcy jurisdiction for unified enforcement to advance the connection between enforcement and bankruptcy.

Basic Facts

In September 2017, the Xiaoshan District People's Court of Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province [hereinafter "Xiaoshan District People's Court"] opened enforcement proceedings on the civil mediation document in the case of Zhejiang Xiaoshan Mou Commercial Bank Co., Ltd., Yinfa Sub-branch [hereinafter "Bank Mou Yinfa Sub-branch"] v. Zhejiang Mou New Materials Co., Ltd. [hereinafter "Zhejiang Mou New Materials Company"] and 12 others (dispute over financial loan contract), with the enforcement subject matter being approximately RMB 100,000,000 yuan. During enforcement, the parties reached a settlement agreement for installment performance, but the judgment debtor did not fully perform its payment obligations. Upon the application of Bank Mou Yinfa Sub-branch, the Xiaoshan District People's Court filed the case for resumed enforcement on November 29, 2021, continuing the seizure of vehicles, land, factory buildings, and machinery and equipment of Zhejiang Mou New Materials Company and other judgment debtors, and commencing the appraisal procedure for the seized property. Bank Mou Yinfa Sub-branch held a mortgage over the aforesaid seized factory buildings.

In August 2021, due to administrative division adjustment, the location of Zhejiang Mou New Materials Company and other judgment debtors was transferred from Xiaoshan District, Hangzhou to Qiantang District, Hangzhou. In 2022, the Qiantang District People's Court of Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province [hereinafter "Qiantang District People's Court"] filed and enforced three labor dispute cases involving Zhejiang Mou New Materials Company, but all were concluded in the current enforcement procedure due to the company's assets being fully seized by the Xiaoshan District People's Court and having no other available property for enforcement. Thereafter, the Qiantang District People's Court successively accepted over a hundred labor dispute cases with Zhejiang Mou New Materials Company as the judgment debtor. Because, prior to the administrative division adjustment, 28 cases with Zhejiang Mou New Materials Company and others as judgment debtors were being enforced by the Xiaoshan District People's Court, and the main assets were also first seized by the Xiaoshan District People's Court and were in the process of disposition, the labor dispute series of enforcement cases accepted by the Qiantang District People's Court with the company as judgment debtor came to a standstill.

In addition, Zhejiang Mou New Materials Company and six affiliated enterprises had total liabilities of over RMB 4 billion, were insolvent, and had filed an application for pre-reorganization with the Qiantang District People's Court.

To resolve the enforcement issues of this series of cases in a "package" manner, on November 2023, the Hangzhou Intermediate People's Court of Zhejiang Province designated the above 28 cases then being enforced by the Xiaoshan District People's Court to the Qiantang District People's Court for unified enforcement.

For the purpose of connecting enforcement with bankruptcy, the Qiantang District People's Court conducted a comprehensive review of the cases involving Zhejiang Mou New Materials Company and other judgment debtors, and convened a meeting with the judgment debtors, creditor representatives, and employee representatives. Upon investigation, the company held independent intellectual property rights, its relevant technologies were at a leading level in the industry, it was in compliance with national industrial policy directions, had favorable industry prospects, had relatively strong potential debt repayment capacity, and had redemption value and possibility.

Judgment

On January 22, 2024, the Qiantang District People's Court rendered Civil Ruling (2024) Zhe 0114 Po Shen No. 2: accepting the bankruptcy reorganization application of Zhejiang Mou New Materials Company. During the reorganization proceedings, Zhejiang Mou New Materials Company and other enterprises lawfully formulated a draft reorganization plan, making arrangements for the satisfaction of claims totaling over RMB 70,000,000 yuan, including employee wages, which was approved by a vote of the creditors' meeting. On June 18, 2024, the Qiantang District People's Court rendered Civil Ruling (2024) Zhe 0114 Po No. 1-6 (II): approving the reorganization plan of Zhejiang Mou New Materials Company and six affiliated enterprises, and terminating the reorganization proceedings.

Reasoning

In this case, multiple cases involved the same judgment debtor, and different people's courts had separately filed and enforced them; during enforcement, the judgment debtor became insolvent and also filed an application for pre-reorganization with the people's court. Special considerations were required on how to lawfully coordinate and prudently handle the series of enforcement cases, and how to coordinate the relationship between the enforcement procedure and the pre-reorganization procedure.

First, the enforcement work was effectively advanced by designating one people's court to enforce in a unified manner. Through designated enforcement, concentrating the series of cases involving the same judgment debtor originally filed and enforced by different people's courts into one people's court for enforcement could effectively resolve the "difficulty in enforcement" caused by multiple simultaneous enforcement actions, overlapping compulsory measures, and inconsistent enforcement strategies. In this case, multiple cases involving the main debts and mortgage debts of Zhejiang Mou New Materials Company and other judgment debtors were being enforced by the Xiaoshan District People's Court; later, due to the administrative division adjustment, several labor dispute cases were being enforced by the Qiantang District People's Court, and Zhejiang Mou New Materials Company had filed an application for pre-reorganization with the Qiantang District People's Court. The Hangzhou Intermediate People's Court lawfully designated the Qiantang District People's Court to unify the enforcement of the related series of cases, which could integrate resources, protect the legitimate rights and interests of all creditors, coordinate the negotiations during the pre-reorganization phase, help the judgment debtor enterprise extricate itself from difficulties and achieve rehabilitation, and better realize the clean-up of enterprise-related enforcement cases and effective rescue of market entities.

Second, the mechanism for connecting enforcement with bankruptcy was smooth to assist enterprise rehabilitation. For cases where the judgment debtor is an enterprise in operational difficulty, measures such as strengthening coordination among case-filing, adjudication, and enforcement could be taken, applying different strategies to advance the connection between enforcement and bankruptcy. For enterprises that are insolvent and have no necessity or possibility of rescue, the bankruptcy liquidation procedure should be applied lawfully for timely liquidation; for enterprises with potential and prospects, efforts should be made to help them resolve crises through bankruptcy reorganization, bankruptcy composition, and other means. In this case, although Zhejiang Mou New Materials Company was insolvent, it held independent intellectual property rights, its relevant technologies were at a leading level in the industry, the industry had favorable prospects, it had relatively strong potential debt repayment capacity, and had redemption value; the relevant pre-reorganization plan had also received support from most creditors, making reorganization feasible. Lawfully applying bankruptcy reorganization not only helped the company to generate vitality and rehabilitate, but also maximized the fair protection of the legitimate rights and interests of all parties, reduced the comprehensive costs of realizing claims, and was conducive to achieving the best outcome for the case.

Relevant Legal Provisions

Article 38 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China

Article 74, Paragraph 2 of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Certain Issues Concerning the Work of Enforcement by People's Courts (for Trial Implementation) (Fa Shi [1998] No. 15, amended in 2020)
